headline: Approved October 19th meeting minutes; discussed the town possibly not renewing the Block Keeper's house lease.
summary: Commissioner Minkema spoke about the Hamden through Time event in November and a future event. Commissioner Osenko asked whether the State would take control of the Block Keeper's house if the lease ends, and Minkema and Levine said they did not know.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the October 19th meeting, with 5 yeas and 2 absent.

decision_evidence.quote: Approval of the minutes from the October 19th meeting. ... Commissioner Banks made a motion to accept October 19th's meeting minutes. ... yeas- 5, absent- 2

plain_text:
TOWN OF HAMDEN, CONNECTICUT 
 
Historic Properties Commission 
Minutes         
         
Regular Meeting 
 
7:00 PM, November 16, 2026 
 
 
 
Hamden Government 
Center 
2750 Dixwell Avenue 
Hamden, CT  06518 
 Click to View Agenda   
  
1. CALL TO ORDER 
  
 Commissioner Minkema called the meeting to order at 7:07PM. 
2. ATTENDANCE 
  
 Present: Todd Levine, Chair; Daniel C. Ioime; Ken Minkema; Joe Banks; Paul J. Geary; 
Mark Osenko. 
 
Also Present: Robert Velez, Clerk. 
3. APPROVAL OF PREVIOUS MEETING MINUTES 
  
 
 
  1. Approval of the minutes from the October 19th meeting.   
  
• Commissioner Banks made a motion to accept October 19th's meeting 
minutes. 
o yeas- 5, absent- 2 
  
4. PUBLIC COMMENT 
  
 There was no public comment. 
5. CORRESPONDENCE 
There will be a brief summary of the correspondence submitted between the last 
correspondence update and this one. This includes but is not limited to any 
correspondence with council members that members wish to submit for the record. It can 
also include written communication to the council from the administration, community 
members, etc.   
 There was no correspondence discussed.
6. EXECUTIVE SESSION 
(if recommended by the town attorney)  
 The commission did not enter executive session. 
7. REPORTS 
  
 
 
  1. The local Register Properties.  
  
• Commissioner Geary had said he had not heard anything about new 
properties.  
 
  2. Historical Society.  
  
 
  3. Hamden Cemeteries.  
  
• Commissioner Minkema asked Commissioner Ioime if he had heard anything 
about the Hamden Cemeteries. 
o Commissioner Ioime said he had not. 
 
8. OLD BUSINESS 
  
 
 
  1. Mile Markers.  
  
• Chairman Levine spoke about the state of the Mile Marker. 
 
  2. Henry Austin Barn.  
  The commission had not heard anything about the Henry Austin Barn. 
  3. Block Keeper's house.  
  
• Commissioner Minkema had spoken about the town not renewing it's lease on 
the Block Keeper's house. 
o He found the possibility of this lease ending concerning. 
o Commissioner Osenko asked if the State would be taking control of the 
Block Keeper's house when the lease is not renewed. 
▪ Commissioner Minkema responded that he did not know. 
▪ Commissioner Minkema asked Chairman Levine if some of the 
commissions coming together would make a difference in the 
lease renewal. 
▪ Chairman Levine responded that he did not know. 
 
9. NEW BUSINESS
• Commissioner Minkema spoke about the Hamden through time event for November 
as well as the next future, Hamden through Time Event. 
 
10. ADJOURNMENT 
  
 
• The meeting adjourned at 7:31PM
